div.head: Abt 59
div.ab: Gif dynt sweart sie buton wædum, XXX scætta gebete.
Gif dynt sweart sie buton wædum, XXX scætta gebete.
Gif dynt sweart sie buton wædum, XXX scætta gebete.
Wenn die Strieme schwarz ist ausserhalb der Kleider, büsse er 30 Skätte.
If the weal is black outside the clothes, let him pay 30 sceattas.
If it leaves a black bruise [showing] outside the clothes, 30 sceattas shall be paid as compensation.
If the [bruise which arises from the] blow should be black outside the clothing, let him pay 30 sceattas [in addition].

note.seg: Dunklen Flecken hinterlässt; vgl. Gl Beule. Auch andere Germanen kennen diese Qualifikation; Wilda 752¹. 773; stokisdynt Schott. Wundbusse 14. Jhs.; Leges Quatuor burg. 17; Seebohm Tribal Agsax. 301

Leaves a dark mark; cf. Gl Beule. Other Germanic peoples also recognise this aggravating circumstance; Wilda 752¹. 773; stokisdynt in a 14th-cent. Scottish tariff of compensation for wounds; Leges Quatuor burg. 17; Seebohm Tribal Agsax. 301
1¹/₂ Schilling, wohl nicht neben dem einen vorigen Satzes
1¹/₂ shillings, probably not in addition to the one shilling of the preceding sentence
